candidates.name: J&R Specialties Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: Section 10 page lists Toilet Partitions as a supply-and-install service. Named projects: Seneca One (installed toilet partitions), Northtown Jaguar Land Rover (supplied and installed Bobrick partitions) and 500 Pearl.

candidates.reason: Commercial Division 10 subcontractor with named toilet partition installs. About 65 miles from Rochester, and its site lists Rochester in its Western NY service area.

license.name: J&R Specialties Inc
license.registry: None applies: New York has no statewide contractor license for this work; City of Rochester (Bureau of Zoning & Permitting) sets no general contractor license
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Under the area rule, partition installation needs no state or Rochester city contractor license, so there is no license registry to look up. The base city is Akron NY, which is outside Rochester. Rochester permit forms ask for job-specific NYS workers' comp proof (C-105.2/U-26.3, CE-200 exemption) with each permit, and require licensed contractors only for plumbing and electrical work (seen in search-result summaries of cityofrochester.gov permit PDFs; the PDF itself returned 403 when fetched). No NY DOS entity search was run because that site is a script-driven app.
